source_algorithm.position: texture coordinate multiplied by physical output dimension
source_algorithm.minimum: start at float 9999, take nearest point distance
source_algorithm.mapped_distance: lerp lower/upper max distance using mean map RGB; alpha ignored
source_algorithm.result: minimum/distance, or 1-result when inverted equals 1; grayscale RGB and alpha 1
source_algorithm.empty_points: processData returns the preexisting output surface

native_limits.profile: GLSL point capacity, deterministic CPU pixel centers, nearest map sampling and white vertex colour
native_limits.empty_points: require a matching held output receipt; fresh or resized empty targets need explicit source observations
native_limits.invalid_division: reject zero or nonfinite mapped divisor before output publication
native_limits.admission: bound all selected processor rows, pixels, points and output storage before rendering

verification: source facts and bounded native profile; validation evidence is recorded separately; licensed renderer parity remains open
comparison_gate: exact source renderer vertex colour, texture state, primitive coverage and storage rounding require licensed matched captures

source_boolean_conversion.rule: numeric input is true only when greater than 0.5

mapped_condition_conversion.rule: Boolean identity; finite linked numeric conditions are true only above 0.5.
